Hi Sergio, it is Marina. One thing before the committee call tomorrow. Claudia will ask you the same question she always asks: will the exposure rise next quarter? Please do not answer with a flat yes. Our forecast points up, but it is only an estimate, and it rests on one assumption about the interest rate. So say it is likely to rise, say it may go further if rates move, and say a fall is unlikely but not impossible. That way you are honest about the uncertainty and you still give her a number to work with. Be confident about the data and cautious about the timing. Talk tomorrow.

Hi Sergio, it is Paulo from the credit desk. About the forecast for the committee. I ran the model twice this morning and the two runs do not agree, so treat every number as an estimate, not a fact. My reading is this. The exposure must be close to the upper band already, because the position has not moved since Monday. It could cross the limit if the currency weakens, although the odds of that are low this month. A breach before September is unlikely. One warning: the whole thing depends on one assumption about funding costs, so name that assumption out loud when you present. If Claudia hears the assumption, she will trust the number. Good luck.
